body:
## Pull request overview

This PR successfully extracts three heavy component types (Markdown, Kanban, Charts) from the `@object-ui/components` core package into separate lazy-loaded plugin packages, reducing the main bundle size by approximately 50% (~900 KB - 1 MB).

**Changes:**
- Created `@object-ui/plugin-markdown` package with lazy-loaded GitHub Flavored Markdown rendering (262 KB gzipped)
- Created `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` package with lazy-loaded drag-and-drop kanban board (79 KB gzipped)
- Enhanced `@object-ui/plugin-charts` with advanced chart rendering capabilities (538 KB gzipped)
- Removed heavy dependencies (react-markdown, recharts, @dnd-kit) from the core components package
- Updated playground with new plugin imports and comprehensive demo examples

### Reviewed changes
